title: Escalations — items requiring a human decision
description: Only things needing a decision. Cycle summaries and routine status belong in history.jsonl.

id.description: ESC-<YYYY-MM-DD>-<AREA>-<NN>. Stable, so log entries can cite it.

status.description: OPEN_ADVISORY is know-about-this, no decision required. Keeping it distinct stops the file becoming a newsfeed.

title.description: One line: what decision is needed, not what was observed.

detail.description: Numbers, source, and the consequence of not deciding.

owner.description: Who must act. An escalation with no owner will not be actioned.
